title: China Southern: London Return from MEL $1082, SYD $1129, PER $1176, ADL $1209, BNE $1320 @ IWantThatFlight
body:
Deal: China Southern: London Return from MEL $1082, SYD $1129, PER $1176, ADL $1209, BNE $1320 @ IWantThatFlight

[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] It's true. It's like putting up a photo of Shoalhaven Heads on the NSW South Coast and calling it Sydney.
[whyisave] It's the anticipated bombing of Iran, by USA,
and this news will tank the stock market, etc…
so..the flight prices are probably pricing in the stock-market shenanigans.
[ATangk] China is not really affected by the flight path diversions in the ME. They fly over Russia too.
[Tyrx] If we're going to speculate geopolitically, wouldn't the reported risk of Russia testing Article 5 with a limited NATO incursion be the more plausible concept? I don't see how further conflict in Iran would decreases prices on this route, especially as China has been one of the "winners" from that conflict in terms of stealing some of the traffic from the middle east for being a transit hub.
[CrocDundee] Unfortunately, IWantThatFlight is no longer the bargain flying site it used to be. 99% of the time I will find flights cheaper than what is advertised through IWantThatFlight.
This sale is no exception. I chose a return flight from Brisbane to London 26 Jan - 22 Feb: Skyscanner $1344 for the exact same flight/inclusions. Plus a little bit of cashback ($8 for flights).
More recently, I searched for return flights to Vietnam. iwantthatflight - approx $750 return… Other site $489 return.
[JaxSantiago] Are they strict with 2 x 23kg? Can't I do 1 luggage only with max 30kg?
[Trein] These flights transfer in China, after 15 Sep, China will implement new border control law and you may be questioned, investigated or even detained at the custom.
[star-ggg] you may be questioned, investigated or even detained at the custom
Just like every other international border area?
[altomic] I love the Australian border control show
